name: syncbox
description: Syncbox — DJ playlist sync for Rekordbox. Local desktop app for controlled Spotify to Rekordbox synchronization.
author: Adrien Didot

scripts.dev:service: cd service && uv run --group dev uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8765
scripts.build:service: cd service && rm -rf build dist && rm -f syncbox-service.spec && uv run --with pyinstaller pyinstaller --noconfirm --onedir --name syncbox-service --collect-all pyrekordbox --collect-all sqlcipher3 --collect-all uvicorn --collect-all mutagen --collect-all pydantic --collect-all certifi --collect-all httpx --collect-all httpcore --collect-submodules app run_service.py
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run build:service && electron-builder --mac --dir
scripts.dist:dmg: npm run build && npm run build:service && electron-builder --mac dmg
scripts.test: npm run test:service && npm run typecheck
scripts.test:service: cd service && uv run --group dev pytest
